description.en: SP-TransientBench (STB) is a real-captured multi-task benchmark for single-photon perception. It comprises 10 diverse scenes and 10,297 views captured with a solid-state single-photon LiDAR at 256×192 resolution, providing full time-of-flight histograms with multi-return behavior, calibrated camera poses, and standardized metadata. The benchmark evaluates depth estimation, multi-view reconstruction, and 3D semantic understanding, with 13-class semantic annotations for selected scenes. Dedicated data splits and evaluation protocols are provided for each task.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing single-photon perception studies rely on simulated or small-scale captures, lacking a systematic real-world evaluation. STB provides a consistent and reproducible benchmark across multiple 3D vision tasks, enabling comparative assessment of algorithms in photon-starved scenarios and advancing active 3D perception research.
